reasons: Dockerfile delegates startup to this script
Container executable symlink resolves to this path
Defines the deployable CLI package and engine constraints
Useful for workspace navigation but not sufficient as the runtime boundary
Large integration catalog is not needed to establish the core workload boundary

design_findings.value: packages/cli is the primary deployable workload package inside a larger production monorepo
/home/node/.n8n is created as the runtime home/config state path
database and queue dependencies vary by execution mode

scanner_misses.description: A flat source scan may find many packages but miss that the production Dockerfile symlink identifies packages/cli/bin/n8n as the executable boundary.
Treating n8n as one HTTP process would miss queue worker and other command modes exposed by the CLI.
Scanning packages/nodes-base deeply before resolving the CLI boundary would consume substantial context without improving Kubernetes workload discovery.

rule_candidates.support: n8n production Dockerfile directly reveals port, home path, entrypoint script, and CLI executable.
n8n root is a monorepo, while the image resolves the executable into packages/cli.
rule_candidates.counterexample: Framework repositories such as nestjs/nest may contain runnable samples without shipping the root as a production application.

action.defer_deep_scan_until: core workload and command modes are resolved

rule_candidates.support: n8n nodes-base is large but not required to identify the main server process.
rule_candidates.counterexample: A custom-node-only deployment analysis may explicitly require the package.

rule_candidates.support: The broad pass already identifies the primary Kubernetes design boundary without scanning all integrations.

stop_decision.reason: The production image establishes the primary runtime boundary. Remaining uncertainty is narrow and should be resolved with targeted CLI/config reads, not a repository-wide scan.

review.notes: Commit is pinned. Dockerfile evidence was inspected through indexed GitHub search, but commit-specific file retrieval was unavailable in the execution environment. Validate all source lines against the pinned checkout before promotion to reviewed.
